senses.gloss: Samekh, name of the fifteenth letter of the Alphabet.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17:6">Gen. R. s. 17</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 23:2">Yalk. ib. 23</cite> <he>מתחלת הספר ועד כאן אין כתיב סמ״ך … נברא סֹטן</he> from the beginning to this verse (<cite ref="Genesis 2:21">Gen. II, 21</cite>) there is no Samekh; when Eve was created Satan (temptation) was created (Gen. R. l. c. <cite ref="O00498"><he>שטן</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Megillah 2b">Meg. 2ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. I, 71ᶜ top <he>ס׳ מעשה ניסים</he> the letter S. (on the tablets of the Ten Commandments) was suspended by a miracle.
<cite ref="Shabbat 66a:8">Sabb. 66ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="O00711"><he>סִימָנָא</he> I</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>סַמְכִין</he>.
